title: Business Development Representative
description:
Buzz Solutions is seeking a strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing team and drive adoption of our AI solutions within the electric utility sector.

Our innovative solutions help electric utility companies enhance grid reliability, optimize operations, and ensure efficient energy distribution. We are at the forefront of transforming the electric utility industry through advanced AI technology.

As a BDR, you will play a critical role in expanding our customer base by owning a territory of enterprise utility accounts and driving new business opportunities within it. This is not a high-volume, top-of-funnel dialing role- it is a strategic, account-based role, where success comes from deep account research, thoughtful planning, and precise, well-timed execution. You will engage prospective clients, qualify opportunities, and set up meetings for our sales team, while working cross-functionally with sales, external partners, solutions, and other teams to align on strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage a defined territory of enterprise utility accounts, developing and executing strategic account plans to build a strong, qualified pipeline.
  • Conduct deep research on each account (organizational structure, priorities, initiatives, and key stakeholders) before engaging, to inform a tailored outreach strategy.
  • Execute intentional, multi-channel outreach (phone, email, social, in-person events) designed around each account's specific challenges and business drivers, rather than high-volume dialing.
  • Engage with prospects to understand their needs, challenges, and budget. Assess fit and ensure leads meet our criteria for the sales team.
  • Schedule meetings and product demonstrations for the sales team with qualified leads.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitors, and market dynamics to effectively position our solutions and provide strategic insight to the broader team.
  • Act quickly and decisively on new information- adjusting account plans and outreach in response to market signals, account developments, or shifting priorities.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of interactions and account plans in our CRM system. Track performance metrics and report on progress regularly.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of sales experience in a quota-carrying or customer-facing role (e.g., account executive, sales development, customer success, business development, or similar). Direct XDR experience is not required, but a track record of success in sales-related work is essential.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own a territory or book of accounts, including building and executing strategic account plans.
  • Strong research skills, with the ability to synthesize information about an account's business, organization, and initiatives into an actionable outreach strategy.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly.
  • Basic understanding of AI technology and its applications in the electric utility industry, or the willingness to quickly learn and stay current with our solutions.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally to align strategy and drive results.
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with the judgment to prioritize and act quickly on the highest-value opportunities within a territory.

title: Computer Vision & Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Job Description

Buzz is revolutionizing the analytics and maintenance of power grid infrastructure through our advanced AI solutions. Our computer vision systems analyze critical infrastructure to enhance safety, reliability, and operational efficiency across the power grid network.

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to advance our computer vision initiatives and help build our foundational model capabilities. You'll bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and production systems, reading papers, adapting novel algorithms, and turning them into reliable, deployed models for power grid analysis. You'll work within a team of experienced ML engineers, with the autonomy to drive your own projects and the support to keep growing.

Responsibilities

Project delivery

  • Own and deliver end-to-end computer vision projects focused on:
    • Equipment defect detection
    • Thermal anomaly identification
    • Vegetation encroachment monitoring
    • Surveillance of closed areas for human and animal intrusion
  • Scope, plan, and execute your own projects from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring.
  • Deliver on client projects, translating client requirements and raw data into working computer vision solutions.
  • Contribute to shared team projects, coordinating with other engineers to deliver against common milestones.

Research and experimentation

  • Stay current with ML/CV research, identify promising methods, and evaluate their applicability to our domain.
  • Adapt and implement algorithms from papers, validating against baselines and benchmarking for production viability.
  • Bring the latest advances in deep learning and generative AI to bear on model training, accuracy, and reliability.
  • Design and execute experiments with systematic hyperparameter tuning, ablation studies, and appropriate baselines.
  • Perform structured error analysis: categorize failure modes (false positives, missed detections, localization errors, misclassifications) and break down performance by data slices (object size, occlusion, image quality).
  • Select and justify model architectures based on task requirements, latency, and accuracy tradeoffs.

Engineering and production

  • Develop production-grade Python libraries for the complete ML lifecycle.
  • Design and implement data pipelines including ingestion, preprocessing, annotation workflows, and quality monitoring.
  • Own experiment tracking and model versioning: configurations, random seeds, dataset versions, environment specs, and model checkpoints.
  • Build model serving pipelines that meet latency and throughput requirements.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and write integration tests for ML pipelines.

Collaboration and craft

  • Share knowledge with teammates and contribute to best practices for model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Advocate for and uphold software quality standards within the ML team.
  • Communicate research findings, technical decisions, and model limitations clearly to stakeholders and clients.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 2-5 years of industry experience in computer vision and machine learning.
  • Solid understanding in modern computer vision and deep neural networks, including:
    • Object detection
    • Semantic segmentation
    • Image classification
    • Vision transformers and foundation models
    • Vision language models
    • Similarity search

  • Experience taking at least one ML model into production and maintaining it there.
  • Experience selecting, fine-tuning, and adapting model architectures (CNNs, transformers, foundation models) for specific use cases.
  • Demonstrated ability to read ML research papers, extract the key ideas, and implement them.
  • Ability to debug training instabilities and conduct systematic error analysis.
  • Proficiency in Python and the core ML stack:
    • PyTorch and Lightning
    • OpenCV
    • NumPy and pandas
    • Scikit-Learn
    • FastAPI and Pydantic
  • Strong software engineering practices, including:
    • Git version control
    • Unit and integration testing (Pytest)
    • CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
    • Docker and reproducible environments
    • Experiment tracking and model versioning
    • ML DevOps
    • Python type hinting
  • Proven ability to own technical projects independently, from problem framing through production deployment.

Desired Additional Experience

  • Multi-modal computer vision
  • Custom object detection model development
  • Generative models for data augmentation
  • Extracting measurements from GIS and/or drone-metadata-enriched imagery
  • Model quantization and latency optimization for edge deployment
  • Systematic hyperparameter tuning at scale
  • Energy, utilities, geospatial, or industrial inspection domains

Additional information:

  • This position does not include sponsorship for United States work authorization.

title: Controller
description:
Our team is seeking an experienced Controller to lead Buzz Solution’s accounting and financial operations. This role will oversee all aspects of financial management, including accounting, financial reporting, budget and forecasts preparation, financial risk management, as well as the development and oversight of internal control policies and procedures. You will work closely with the executive leadership team to drive performance through financial reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee all day-to-day accounting operations, including general ledger, and fixed assets
  • Manage the month-end and year-end close processes
  • Establish and document policies, procedures, and best practices for the finance function
  • Own the full-cycle accounts payable process: vendor onboarding and W-9/1099 setup, purchase-order and invoice matching, GL coding, approval routing, payment runs, and vendor reconciliations and inquiries.
  • Reconcile the AR and AP subledgers to the general ledger each period and maintain the related accrual and allowance estimates, including the allowance for credit losses.
  • Build and maintain robust internal controls to support future audit cycles and diligence processes
  • Prepare timely, accurate GAAP financial statements and the monthly management reporting package, with variance analysis against budget and prior period.
  • Manage tax filings, sales tax compliance, and multi-state nexus considerations
  • Proactively identify compliance risks and implement corrective measures
  • Own cash management, bank reconciliations, and short-term cash forecasting.
  • Forecast working-capital needs and time funding and disbursements against the cash position.
  • Provide recommendations to improve financial performance and resource allocation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field
  • CPA license, preferred
  • 8+ years of progressive public accounting (audit) background, ideally with technology or SaaS clients.
  • Proven experience owning the full accounting cycle and close process
  • Knowledge of GAAP, financial reporting, and internal tools
  • Familiarity with SaaS business models and relevant metrics (ARR, ACV,CAC, burn rate)
  • Experience supporting fundraising processes and investor reporting

Anticipated Pay Range: $120,000 - $140,000

Benefits: Health, Dental &Vision insurance, 401k Contributions, Unlimited Paid Time Off, STD/LTD,

title: Head of Customer Success - Southeast Region
description:
About Us

Buzz Solutions safeguards the world's energy infrastructure by providing AI-based actionable insights and predictive analytics for power line and energy infrastructure inspections. We are disrupting the power utility industry by bringing automation to inspection and maintenance operations through our AI-powered software platform, and we are a venture-funded startup looking for great talent to share our vision of energy industry transformation.

Our solutions allow utilities to reduce current inspection operation costs by at least 50%, prevent power outages, prevent wildfires, and manage their assets effectively. You will work alongside a talented, passionate, and hardworking team of engineers and product managers building the technology that helps our customers prevent outages, forced shutdowns, and wildfires, and manage the impact of climate change on aging grid infrastructure.

Job Description

Buzz Solutions is seeking a Head of Customer Success with deep roots in the utility industry and proven success in a fast-scaling startup environment.

You will start as an individual contributor, owning post-sale customer relationships, driving platform adoption, ensuring long-term customer value, and serving as a trusted advisor to our utility partners. You will act as the bridge between our customers and our engineering, product, and sales teams.

This is a player-coach role. As our customer base expands, you will take on full leadership of the Customer Success team, setting strategy, building the processes and playbooks the function runs on, and hiring and developing CSMs. We are looking for someone who has led teams before and wants to build a function from an early stage rather than inherit a mature one.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end post-sale customer experience, serving as the primary point of contact for our electric utility customers and partners.
  • Drive deep engagement within the Buzz Solutions platform, ensuring customers realize ongoing ROI that supports renewal and long-term retention.
  • Identify and surface expansion opportunities such as new use cases, additional circuits or regions, and expanded inspection volume, using product adoption, usage data, and customer outcomes. Partner with the Sales team to develop these opportunities; Sales owns the close.
  • Advocate for customers and their needs internally to influence product direction and roadmap priorities.
  • Identify at-risk customers who are not achieving their desired outcomes and lead the effort to get them back on track.
  • Organize training sessions, product deep dives, and enablement efforts so customers get the most out of our platform.
  • Maintain accurate account health, engagement, and adoption data in Salesforce and our broader customer success tooling.
  • Build and document the processes, playbooks, and success metrics the Customer Success function will scale on, and help set the standard for the team as it grows.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: Fully ramped on the Buzz platform and our AI-based inspection workflows. Introduced to and building relationships with every account in your book.
  • Six months: Running a consistent QBR and executive check-in cadence across your accounts, with documented success metrics and ROI tied to each customer's inspection program.
  • Nine months: Established a repeatable onboarding and enablement playbook that shortens time-to-value for new utility customers, and become a resource the rest of the CS team leans on as the team scales.
  • Twelve months: Strong retention and renewal across your book, a healthy pipeline of expansion opportunities handed to Sales, a documented set of customer-driven product priorities influencing the roadmap, and a clear point of view on how the Customer Success function should be structured and staffed as we scale.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in a SaaS Customer Success role.
  • Experience leading or managing a Customer Success team, whether as a formal people manager, a team lead, or a senior CSM who mentored and set direction for others.
  • A track record of building process from scratch, including (both internal and external) onboarding frameworks, health scoring, QBR cadences, escalation paths, and playbooks, rather than only operating within someone else's.
  • Direct experience in the electric utility industry, or selling and supporting technology into utilities. Working familiarity with transmission and distribution operations, asset inspection and maintenance, vegetation management, wildfire mitigation, or utility procurement and capital planning cycles.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly to both field and executive audiences.
  • Comfort discussing AI and computer vision concepts with technical customers, including model performance, false positives and negatives, and confidence thresholds, with the credibility to set accurate expectations rather than overpromise.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to understand client needs and provide tailored solutions.
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with a proven track record of driving customer outcomes.
  • Experience working in Salesforce and other enterprise-level systems.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and contribute to a positive team environment.

  • Only considering candidates in the Southeast region of the U.S.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at an early-stage or venture-funded startup, particularly as an early member of a Customer Success function.
  • Background in AI, machine learning, or geospatial/imagery-based software products.
  • Experience converting pilots and proofs of concept into production, enterprise-wide deployments.
  • Experience hiring, onboarding, and developing CSMs as a team scales.

* Buzz Solutions does not provide Visa sponsorship for work authorizations in the United States at this time *

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Buzz Solutions

Buzz Solutions builds visual AI for the power grid. Our PowerAI platform turns utility inspection imagery — drone, helicopter, and fixed camera — into operational intelligence, analyzing an image in under a second instead of the one to two minutes it takes a human reviewer. We work across transmission, distribution, substations, and solar, helping some of the largest utilities in North America catch failing components before they become outages and compress inspection cycles that once ran for years.

We recently closed a $20M Series A to accelerate our products. We're an early growth-stage company with a small team and a problem that doesn't wait: load is growing, storm seasons keep arriving, and most of the largest machine ever built is still inspected by eye.

About the Role

This is our first Forward Deployed Engineer — a hands-on technical partner embedded with customers and our go-to-market team, and a bridge between Sales, Product, and Engineering.

Before the deal, you're scoping: on discovery calls with utility engineering and operations teams, sizing what an implementation actually takes, running pilots, and clearing the technical objections that stall a sales cycle. After the deal, you're deploying: standing up PowerAI in customer environments, building the integrations into the systems they already use, and leaning on AI workflows to deliver in weeks what traditionally took months.

This is a hands-on role, not a program or product management one. You'll be in the systems, writing the integration, and on the call with the customer's engineers. Nobody hands you a spec, and you don't hand one to someone else.

The role exists for two reasons. Our customers need a technical counterpart who can move at their pace and build alongside them. And the patterns you uncover in the field should make Buzz stronger: solve customer-specific problems quickly, then turn recurring needs into reusable deployment capabilities and clear input for the core product.

Roughly 80% of your time is customer-facing, split across pre-sales scoping and deployment. The remaining 20% points inward: building reusable deployment tooling and AI agents and translating field patterns into product and engineering improvements.

You'll report directly to our CTO and work in tight partnership with Sales, Product, Solutions, and core Engineering. As our first FDE, you'll help define how the function operates and lay the foundation for a broader Forward Deployed Engineering team as we scale.

What You'll Do

Pre-sales partnership

  • Ride alongside Sales as the technical partner. Join discovery calls, understand the customer's inspection workflow and data reality, and translate it into what a Buzz deployment looks like for them.
  • Scope and size implementations before anything is signed — integration effort, data requirements, timeline, and what's genuinely in and out of reach.
  • Run pilots and proofs of value that prove the platform against the customer's own imagery and assets, not a canned demo.
  • Clear technical objections. Handle architecture questions, security review, and the data-handling scrutiny that comes with regulated utility buyers.

Deployment and Implementation

  • Own deployments end to end — configuration, integration, validation, and handoff — for customers with real operational constraints.
  • Build the integrations that connect PowerAI to customer systems: asset management, GIS, inspection data pipelines, and reporting tools.
  • Use AI workflows to compress delivery. Turn what would be bespoke engineering work into repeatable, agent-assisted implementation, so delivery speed isn't capped by headcount.
  • Find and scope expansion. You'll be closer to the customer's operation than anyone else. Spot the next use case, size what it takes, and hand Sales a qualified, technically validated opportunity.
  • Bridge field and core engineering. Solve what you can in the field, identify recurring patterns that belong in the product, and bring back clear, reproducible requirements rather than one-off escalations.

Product and Internal Enablement (~20%)

  • Build and ship reusable deployment tooling and AI agents across customer delivery and GTM workflows — and drive the adoption that makes them stick.
  • Turn field patterns into product leverage. Package recurring customer needs into reusable assets and clear product/engineering input so each deployment gets faster and the platform gets stronger.

Your First 90 Days

  • Days 1–30: Learn the platform deeply, shadow active deployments and sales calls, and meet the accounts you'll support.
  • Days 31–60: Scope a live opportunity alongside Sales, and run a deployment end to end as the technical lead.
  • Days 61–90: Surface and scope an expansion inside an existing account, and ship your first reusable deployment capability or internal AI agent.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years in solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, implementation, or professional services at a technical product company — hands on the keyboard, owning customer outcomes.
  • Pre-sales experience. You've partnered with account executives through a sales cycle: running technical discovery, scoping implementations before signature, and being the person the customer's engineers trust in the room.
  • Strong Python or TypeScript, and genuine fluency integrating third-party systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic systems — prompting, tool use, retrieval, orchestration, and evaluation. You've put something agentic in front of real users, not just prototyped.
  • Enterprise credibility. You've navigated security review and architecture scrutiny, and can hold your own with skeptical engineers on the other side of the table.
  • An eye for the next opportunity. You notice when a customer problem is something we could solve, and you can scope it well enough for Sales to act on.
  • Genuine comfort with ambiguity. You can walk into an undefined problem, pick a direction, and ship.
  • Excellent communication. You can explain a technical tradeoff to a utility operations director and a customer constraint to an engineer, and be understood by both.
  • Willingness to travel roughly 40% of the time for customer sites and team onsites.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in utilities, energy, or another regulated industry with long enterprise sales cycles
  • Familiarity with computer vision, geospatial data, or large-scale imagery pipelines

title: Vice President of Marketing
description:
About Us

Our team is looking for an experienced Vice President of Marketing to join our ever growing team! Ideally, we are looking for someone who has an abundance of experience in helping companies grow into their next stage of growth. We're looking for a leader who can move fluidly between setting the vision and helping build it. Someone equally comfortable shaping brand strategy in a leadership meeting and rolling up their sleeves to help a campaign ship.

Responsibilities

  • Build and own our demand generation strategy — campaigns, audience segmentation, and lead nurturing — with clear pipeline targets tied to revenue goals.
  • Bring a results-driven, ROI-minded approach to every campaign and channel investment and evolve our marketing tech stack to scale efficiently as we grow.
  • Partner closely with Sales on pipeline goals, lead handoffs, and reporting that connects marketing activity directly to revenue.
  • Own our brand identity, voice, and market positioning — sharpening the story that differentiates us from legacy competitors and emerging alternatives.
  • This is one of the most important parts of the role: elevate our narrative and messaging to resonate at the executive level, giving our sales team the C-suite-ready story and value propositions they need to close large enterprise utility deals.
  • Build our thought leadership presence — white papers, research reports, and executive-level insight content — that builds credibility with senior utility buyers before Sales ever gets in the room.
  • Represent Buzz Solutions at high-profile speaking engagements and industry events, building the market presence that shortens sales cycles and warms the ground for our sales team.
  • Partner with Product on go-to-market positioning and launch strategy for new capabilities.
  • Lead, coach, and grow our marketing team, bringing structure and process to a function that's ready to scale.
  • Serve as a key member of the leadership team, contributing to company strategy and cross-functional priorities.
  • Bring a collaborative, transparent, and data-driven leadership style — the trait we value most in this hire.
  • Until we bring on dedicated event support, own the strategy and execution for our conference, trade show, and speaking presence — evaluating and prioritizing opportunities based on ROI, visibility, and relationship value.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role, including direct ownership of demand generation strategy and results.
  • A track record of elevating brand and messaging to resonate with senior and executive audiences, ideally in complex or technical B2B markets.
  • Experience marketing enterprise B2B SaaS solutions, ideally into traditional or regulated industries; utility industry knowledge is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • Experience at a growth-stage company navigating a similar inflection point — scaling a brand and a marketing function alongside rapid company growth.
  • A collaborative, transparent, and direct communication style, with genuine enthusiasm for coaching and developing a team.
  • A hands-on mindset — comfortable setting strategy and rolling up your sleeves to help execute it.
